holdings.name: Mankind Pharma Ltd.

what_changed.text: June 2026 sales reached Rs 4,031 crore with net profit of Rs 574 crore, up from Rs 3,443 crore and Rs 559 crore in March 2026.
The statutory auditor of material subsidiary BSV resigned on September 28, 2026 amid voluntary liquidation proceedings.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding Mankind Pharma at 3.42% makes it the fund's largest reported stock. Its 3-month decline of -7.79% detracted -0.266 percentage points from fund returns.

watch.text: Board meeting and earnings call scheduled for October 26, 2026 to review Q2 and half-year results.

holdings.name: Bharat Heavy Electricals Ltd

what_changed.text: September 2026 revenue increased 24% year-on-year to Rs 9,300 crore and net profit rose to Rs 821 crore, supported by an order book of Rs 2.58 lakh crore.
The board sanctioned Rs 500 crore for additional facilities at HEEP-Haridwar and cleared a merger effective November 1, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 3.20% weight, BHEL is the fund's second largest holding. While flat over 3 months (-0.26%), it has gained 40.42% over 6 months and 84.16% over 1 year.

watch.text: Implementation of the merger scheduled for November 1, 2026.

holdings.name: One 97 Communications Ltd

what_changed.text: June 2026 revenue rose to Rs 2,448 crore with net profit of Rs 220 crore and operating margin at 8%.
Subsidiary FGTPL received a GST demand of Rs 703.66 crore on October 13, 2026.
NPCI deferred the rollout of merchant discount rates on select UPI P2M transactions until after Diwali.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 3.15% of the fund, the stock delivered a 25.80% return over 3 months, making it the top performance contributor at +0.813 percentage points.

watch.text: Board review of Q2 FY2027 results on October 26, 2026, followed by an investor call on October 27.
Regulatory decisions following Diwali regarding UPI P2M merchant discount rate implementations.

holdings.name: Multi Commodity Exchange Of India Ltd

what_changed.text: June 2026 revenue stood at Rs 702 crore with operating profit of Rs 494 crore and an operating margin of 70%.
Received a GST show cause notice proposing Rs 54.08 crore in tax, Rs 43.82 crore in interest, and Rs 5.41 crore in penalties on September 29, 2026.
Reorganized key leadership roles across Strategy, Metals, and Base Metals on October 8, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 2.96% allocation, the stock generated a 14.24% 3-month return, adding +0.422 percentage points to fund returns.

watch.text: Board meeting on November 3, 2026 to review Q2 and half-year FY2026 unaudited results.

holdings.name: L&T Finance Holdings Ltd

what_changed.text: Q2 FY27 business update reported estimated retail disbursements of Rs 24,000 crore and retail loan book expansion of 27% to 29% YoY to Rs 1,34,500 crore.
Allotted 80,000 non-convertible debentures worth Rs 800 crore via private placement on October 12, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.94% weight, the stock fell -15.36% over 3 months, producing an estimated drag of -0.452 percentage points.

watch.text: Detailed strategy update and full financial performance disclosure at the scheduled Q2 investor meet.

holdings.name: AU Small Finance Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Provisional Q2 FY27 updates showed deposits growing 28.6% year-on-year to Rs 1.70 lakh crore and gross loan portfolio increasing 25.1%.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.93% weight in the portfolio, its -3.13% return over 3 months created a mild drag within the fund's 26.2% financials basket.

watch.text: Board meeting and group analyst call on October 24, 2026 to approve Q2 FY2026-27 results.

holdings.name: Indusind Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Provisional Q2 updates showed advances rising 11.2% and deposits rising 10.1% as of September 30, 2026.
June 2026 net profit recovered to Rs 1,037 crore from Rs 594 crore in March 2026, with gross NPA declining to 3.25%.
Launched a dedicated banking vertical catering to Global Capability Centres (GCCs).

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 2.92% position, its -12.64% drop over 3 months detracted -0.369 percentage points from fund performance.

watch.text: Upcoming earnings call scheduled for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026.

holdings.name: Max Financial Services Ltd

what_changed.text: Subsidiary Axis Max Life issued Rs 686 crore in subordinated debentures via private placement on September 28, 2026.
Axis Max Life partnered with Tata Digital Group Company to expand life insurance distribution.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 2.81% of the fund, the stock dropped -19.10% over 3 months, generating a -0.537 percentage point negative contribution.

watch.text: Board consideration of Q2 and half-year results on October 27, 2026.

holdings.name: Max Healthcare Institute Ltd

what_changed.text: June 2026 revenue was Rs 2,366 crore with net profit of Rs 323 crore and operating margin at 25%.
CARE reaffirmed the company's AA+ stable and A1+ credit ratings on October 8, 2026.
NCLT proceedings regarding BRS Capital petitions were adjourned to October 29, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: A 2.75% allocation faced a steep -21.87% return over 3 months, making it the fund's largest negative contributor at -0.601 percentage points.

watch.text: NCLT hearing scheduled for October 29, 2026 regarding Kalinga Hospital petitions.

holdings.name: The Federal Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: CARE reaffirmed the bank's issuer and bond ratings at AA+ Stable on October 9, 2026.
Launched the Verto Resident Savings Account on October 7, 2026.
June 2026 financing profit reached Rs 659 crore with net profit at Rs 1,302 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Carrying a 2.71% weight, the stock gained 2.57% over 3 months, providing relative stability against declines in other banking holdings.

watch.text: Board meeting and investor call on October 16, 2026 for Q2 FY27 financial results.

portfolio.statement: Tata Mid Cap Fund posted a 3-month return of -6.01%, weighed down by concentrated weakness in private lenders, non-bank financials, and healthcare names.
interp: Substantial declines in Max Healthcare Institute (-21.87%), Max Financial Services (-19.10%), and L&T Finance (-15.36%) dragged down total portfolio return despite positive gains from One 97 Communications and MCX.
Financials form the largest sector allocation at 26.2%, making portfolio performance particularly sensitive to divergent trends across NBFCs, private banks, and exchange operators.
portfolio.line: Gains in market infrastructure and digital payment holdings were offset by sharp sell-offs in healthcare and financial holdings.

drivers.text: One 97 Communications surged 25.80% over 3 months, contributing +0.813 percentage points to fund performance.
Max Healthcare Institute declined -21.87% over 3 months, reducing fund returns by -0.601 percentage points amid sector concerns over drug price caps.
Max Financial Services dropped -19.10% over 3 months, creating a -0.537 percentage point negative contribution.

themes.title: Capital Goods & Manufacturing Momentum
themes.text: BHEL continues to display strong operational visibility, supported by a Rs 2.58 lakh crore order book and a 24% revenue expansion.

themes.title: Divergent Financial Services Trends
themes.text: Strong volume expansion benefited transaction platforms like MCX, whereas lending institutions and insurers like L&T Finance and Max Financial faced valuation contractions.
holdings: Multi Commodity Exchange Of India Ltd

macro.why: Regulatory interventions including drug price caps and Supreme Court notices have created sector-wide headwinds for hospital operators and pharmaceutical manufacturers.
Regulatory timelines from NPCI concerning UPI merchant discount rates directly impact transaction monetization timelines for fintech firms.

priced_in.text: BHEL's order backlog of Rs 2.58 lakh crore and high trailing P/E of 56.05 reflect strong execution expectations following an 84.16% 1-year run.

could_change.title: Diwali UPI MDR Policy Resolution
could_change.text: Any policy decision taken after Diwali regarding the implementation of UPI P2M merchant discount rates will impact unit economics for payment service providers.

could_change.title: Resolution of Tax and Legal Claims
could_change.text: Pending GST demands against One 97 subsidiary FGTPL (Rs 703.66 crore) and MCX (Rs 54.08 crore) could influence earnings if liabilities crystallize.

portfolio.risk_note: A heavy 26.2% allocation to Financials combined with 12.6% in Healthcare concentrates nearly 39% of the fund in sectors currently undergoing regulatory and margin adjustments.
